newsitem.title: USA: Cragar Industries in strategic pact.
newsitem.headline: Cragar Industries in strategic pact.

text.p: Cragar Industries Inc said Friday it had formed a strategic alliance with OE Enterprises Inc to develop high-end products in the automotive aftermarket.
The alliance was established to design and engineer innovative styles for a number of aftermarket segments including truck, luxury/sport and street high performance, the company said.
OE, an industrial design and engineering firm, will also be responsible for the development and testing of production tooling and international standards compliance, the company said.
